'''Dorelle Caromon''' was a city in [[Eharon]], which was part of the [[Ten Nations]].

During their construction after the [[Breaking of the World]], [[Ogier]] built a [[Ways|waygate]] to Dorelle Caromon.{{ref/book|6|20}} The city later became the city of [[Illian]].
